meta.title: Tailor Your CV to Any Job Link | FitMyCV
meta.description: Tailor your CV and cover letter to any job link: AI keyword matching, a free ATS resume checker, 19 ATS-safe templates, and one-click PDF export.
meta.ogTitle: FitMyCV: Tailor Your CV to Any Job Link in Seconds
meta.ogAlt: FitMyCV: Land more interviews with a CV that fits
meta.schemaName: Tailor Your CV to Any Job Link
meta.howToName: How to tailor your CV to a job link
meta.howToDescription: Paste a job link, let FitMyCV rewrite your CV against the role's requirements, then download the CV and cover letter as PDFs.

hero.videoLabel: FitMyCV demo: paste a job link and download a tailored CV
hero.checkerTitle: Check your CV against a job posting, free
hero.checkerBody: No sign-up. Your file is read in your browser.
hero.titleMain: Paste any job link. Get a CV <accent>made for that role</accent>.
hero.body: Upload your CV once. FitMyCV reads the listing and rewrites your CV in the words that role asks for.
hero.priceNote: ${price} once to download PDFs and apply.

problem.title: You are not being turned down. You are being filtered out.
problem.body: Most companies screen with software before a recruiter sees anything. If your CV misses the words the posting uses, it is dropped. Quietly, and with no reply to tell you why.
problem.missingTitle: Five terms the posting asks for that your CV never says
problem.footer: FitMyCV reads the posting, finds the terms you are missing, and rewrites your CV to use them. Only from experience you actually have.

howItWorks.title: One paste. No rewrites. No guesswork.
howItWorks.priceNote: Preview on screen free. ${price} once to download PDFs.

templates.title: Nineteen layouts, all built to survive a parser
templates.body: Single column, standard headings, no graphics that scramble on extraction. Change the colour and the font on any of them.

trust.title: What you are handing over, and what happens to it
trust.body: Your CV is the most personal document you own. Here is exactly how it is handled.

yours.title: Your CV stays yours
yours.body: Your reference CV is stored against your account and used only to generate your own documents.

notShared.title: Never shared with recruiters
notShared.body: We are not a job board and not a CV database. Nothing you upload is sold, listed, or shown to employers.

delete.title: Delete everything, any time
delete.body: Remove your CV, your tailored documents, and your account from the dashboard whenever you want.

boards.title: Works with the major boards
boards.body: Paste a link from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, or a company careers page, with no copy-pasting job text.

pdf.title: ATS-safe PDF export
pdf.body: Single-column, text-based PDFs with standard headings, so parsers read them the way you wrote them.

cancel.title: Cancel whenever
cancel.body: No contract and no cancellation flow to fight. Access runs to the end of the period you paid for.

trust.methodBody: We read the job posting at the link you paste, pull out its requirements and keywords, then rewrite your CV against them. Every line comes from the CV you uploaded. The model is instructed never to invent employers, roles, or numbers you did not give it.
trust.policies: The claims above are covered by our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and <terms>terms and conditions</terms>. Questions about any of it go to <mail>{email}</mail>.

faq.heading: I kept rewriting my CV for every job link I clicked.
faq.story1: I kept rewriting my CV for every job link I clicked. Each application took longer to prep than to submit.
faq.story2: So I built FitMyCV. Paste a job link and it reads the posting, then rewrites your CV and cover letter for that role. No copying requirements into a form.
faq.story3: I use FitMyCV on my own applications. If it saves me time on every link, it should do the same for you.
faq.title: Honest answers.

resources.title: Everything else on the site
resources.body: Free tools and guides, whether or not you ever pay us a penny.

tailor.label: Tailor a CV from a job link
tailor.body: The flagship flow: paste a posting URL, get a tailored CV and cover letter.

match.label: Resume job match checker
match.body: Paste a resume and a posting. See the match, missing skills, and what to fix first.

ats.label: Free ATS resume checker

atsGuide.label: How to write an ATS-friendly resume
atsGuide.body: Formatting, keywords, and the mistakes that get CVs filtered out before a human reads them.

examples.label: Resume examples for fourteen jobs
examples.body: Worked summaries, before-and-after bullets, and the keywords those postings use.

coverLetterDemo.body: FitMyCV reads the job description and writes a tailored, professional cover letter in seconds, in your voice.
coverLetterDemo.note: Every letter is unique, written to match the exact job, company, and your background.

webview.title: Open in your browser to sign in
webview.warning: Google does not allow sign in inside the LinkedIn app. Use Chrome or Safari, or continue with email which works here.
webview.howTo: How to open in your browser
webview.ios1: Tap the ••• or share icon at the top right of LinkedIn.
webview.ios2: Choose Open in Browser or Open in Safari.
webview.ios3: Sign in with Google once the page reloads in Safari.
webview.android1: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
webview.android2: Choose Open in Chrome or Open in browser.
webview.android3: Sign in with Google once the page reloads in Chrome.
webview.desktop1: Copy the sign in link below.
webview.desktop2: Paste it in Chrome or Safari.
webview.emailNote: Email sign in works inside LinkedIn. No need to switch browser.
webview.toastCopied: Link copied. Paste it in Chrome or Safari.
webview.toastCopyFailed: Could not copy. Long press the link to copy it.
webview.toastOpening: Opening in Chrome. If nothing happens, use Copy link.
